text.en:
All monetary contributions and the equivalent monetary value of works of art, manuscript, books
or other articles of cultural, historical or scientific significance, donated to the National Museum, the National
Library and the National Historical Institute, are tax exempt and deductible from the taxable income of the

The Director of the National Museum, the Director of the National Library and the Chairman of
the National Historical Institute, in the case of the national archives, are each hereby authorized to convene a
panel of experts who shall pass on the merit of the item or items offered as donation to their respective
collections and shall determine the valuation thereof.
All laws inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of January, 1974.
